summary: Full backend + frontend testing of FixitZ MVP. 28/28 pytest backend tests pass (100%). All frontend flows (Home, Repair, Shop, Sell, Buy, Auth, Admin) load and function correctly. Repair pricing engine verified (2.5x/2.3x/2.0x tiers). Sell quote breakdown validated. Admin gating (403 for user, 200 for admin), CRUD for products/sections, settings update, order status update all pass. Razorpay create-order returns valid order_id with LIVE keys (no real payment attempted). Coupon validation and min-order rules work.

issues: Slide heading text has low contrast on some slides (e.g., 'Sell your old phone' white text on light-ish repair image); consider stronger dark gradient overlay

Multiple ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED console errors from external image hosts (images.unsplash.com / logo.clearbit.com) — some images fail to load intermittently. Consider self-hosting critical brand/hero images or adding fallback

action_items: (Optional) Admin nav data-testid is generated from first word of label (e.g., 'Homepage Sections' -> admin-nav-homepage, 'Shop Products' -> admin-nav-shop, 'App Settings' -> admin-nav-app). This is functional but does not match the semantic naming implied by the spec (admin-nav-sections/products/settings). Consider using stable keys.
(Optional) Add dark gradient overlay behind hero banner heading text to improve contrast.
(Optional) Host brand logos locally to avoid clearbit / unsplash DNS failures in console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 630+ lines — approaching split threshold; consider splitting auth, admin CRUD, payments into separate routers.
CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — acceptable for JWT-in-header, but if cookies are added later this must change to explicit origins.
seed_admin resets password if it changed — good idempotent behavior.
bcrypt hashes produced via bcrypt.gensalt() (format $2b$) — verified via code path.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (5 failed attempts should lock account per playbook) — not implemented.
compute_repair_price uses base<800 x2.5, 800-1300 x2.3, >1300 x2 as spec'd; boundary at 800 goes to 2.3 branch which matches spec ('800-1300').
Public /api/sell/quote does not require auth — anyone can compute prices (probably intended for pre-signup UX).
Admin /admin/{collection} generic CRUD accepts arbitrary fields — no per-collection validation. Fine for MVP but adds risk of shape drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: home, repair 4-step, shop add-to-cart, sell quote+book, buy filters, login, admin dashboard/CRUD)
